arStrings.szText: {c_important}{b}{u}Mystic Circles{/u}{/b}{/c} are a subpower that the Spiritborn can gain access to primarily through Legendary Aspects. Appearing in combat as spirit-enhanced areas, these circles can grant you a variety of bonuses based on which one you incorporate into your build. Each Spirit Guardian has synergies with the Mystic Circle, but should you choose to do so, you can create the ultimate Mystic Circle that conveys all benefits at once.
